summary.text: Heaven and Earth Travel is a killer move Fang Yuan had already created when Jade flow pearl was no longer suitable because of his enormous dao marks.

claims.text: With the help of over nine thousand heaven path dao marks, heaven and earth travel directly sent Fang Yuan to the nearby Earth Treasury. In the heart of the mighty earth vein, he withstood the strong pressure leisurely and stored the whole Earth Treasury into his immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan grabs an exposed immortal aperture, then deactivates the compound battlefield killer move and uses heaven and earth travel to leave the place. Soon the immortal aura leaks, and surrounding ancient desolate beasts and immemorial desolate beasts are attracted. After arriving at a safe location, he tosses Fire Plain Grotto Lord’s immortal aperture into the sky.

Ke Xin Hong’s diplomatic mission to Wu clan succeeds and obtains Hu Land. Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move Heaven and Earth Travel. At the next moment he moves from Eastern Sea to Southern Border, appearing in front of Ke Xin Hong. After putting Ke Xin Hong in the sovereign immortal aperture, Fang Yuan returns to Eastern Sea. He secretly arrives in a nameless sea area, toys with Hu Land, and waits for Qi Sea Ancestor.

Eastern Sea’s blue dragon whale has abundant resources. Ever since Fang Yuan last left, he has not been able to find any traces of it. He had used the killer move heaven and earth travel to try to enter the blue dragon whale’s immortal aperture, but failed mysteriously every time.

Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move Heaven and Earth Travel. At the next moment his main body goes from Eastern Sea to Southern Border. A tall mountain peers into the clouds, frost energy emanating from it, its mountain roots already cut. Fang Yuan is here to retrieve Frosty Peak after the preparations are done. Wu clan sold it to him. Variant human Gu Immortals he dispatched are there, and Wu clan’s Gu Immortals are there as well, Wu Yong among them.

After putting Frosty Peak into the sovereign immortal aperture and speaking with Wu Yong and Lu Wei Yin, Fang Yuan says he has other matters to attend to. Heaven and earth travel is activated, and Fang Yuan vanishes on the spot. He goes to Rotten Mud Mountain and takes the mountain.

Lu Wei Yin shouts that Star Constellation will unite the three great worlds and destroy Paradise Earth’s tomb, and that they must go and stop her. Spectral Soul’s main body is a genuine Dao Lord inside the Door of Life and Death. Fang Yuan had already tried heaven and earth travel secretly, but it had no effect. Heavenly Court knew Fang Yuan had Fixed Immortal Travel Immortal Gu. No killer move was invincible. Ghostly concealment likewise showed no effect inside the Door of Life and Death.
